subjects.name: Industrial Chemistry
subjects.scheme_line_print: 5 | RPL401 | Industrial Chemistry | 3-1-0 | ESE:70 CT:20 TA:10 | Total:100 | Credit:4
subjects.locator: p.3 (IV-SEMESTER scheme row 5); detailed syllabus p.4

units.1: Stereoisomerism: Geometrical isomerism with and without chirality, concept of aromaticity directive influence of substitute. Criteria & techniques of purity of compounds. Melting point, Boiling point, recrystallisation, various distillations. Distillation of petroleum, refining of various fraction, Cracking.
units.2: Chemical Kinetics: Kinetics of parallel side, opposite, consecutive and chain reactions, fast reactions fundamental aspect of kinetics of reactions in solution. Catalysis: Acid basis catalysis, Enzyme catalysis, heterogeneous reactions.
units.3: Reactions, Synthesis & mechanism: Hydrocarbons including cyclic, alcohol, phenols, aldehyde & ketones, carboxylic acids & their derivatives, halides, nitro, amino & diazo compounds.
units.4: Conformational analysis: Various terms, conformation analysis of ethane, cyclohexane & 1,2 disubstituted cyclohexane Heterocyclic: Classification, preparation and properties of pyridine. Bimolecules: Structures & reactions of mono & disaccharides, proteins.
units.5: Surface chemistry: adsorption, adsorption isotherms, surface tension and its determination. Colloids chemistry: General preparation properties and classification hydrophilic and lypophobic sols.

reference_books.book: Finar, IL, “Organic Chemistry: Vol. I & II”.
Willard Merit & Dean “Instrumental Methods of Chemical Analysis”.
Skoog& West “Instrumental Methods of Chemical Analysis”.

subjects.name: Fundamentals of Polymer Science
subjects.scheme_line_print: 6 | RPL402 | Fundamentals of Polymer Science | 3-0-0 | ESE:70 CT:20 TA:10 | Total:100 | Credit:3
subjects.locator: p.3 (IV-SEMESTER scheme row 6); detailed syllabus p.5

units.1: History of polymer science, Classification of Polymers, Functionality and structure of polymers, Physical properties and characterization of polymers, effect of structure on properties of polymers, Inorganic polymers. Concept of macromolecules. Stereochemistry of polymers.
units.2: Introduction, Chain & step growth polymerization, Polymerisation techniques, Kinetics of Polymerisation (Free radical, Cationic, Anionic polymerization, Polycondensation).
units.3: Molecular weight, Number average and weight average molecular weight, Sedimentation and Viscosity average molecular weight, Molecular weight and degree of polymerization, Polydispersity, Size of polymer molecules.
units.4: Glass transition temperature, Transitions, significance and factors influencing the Tg. Effect of Plasticizers on Tg. Glass transition of copolymers. Morphology and order of Polymers, Crystallinity in polymers, Degree of crystallinity and Polymer crystallization.Effect of crystallinity on properties of Polymers.
units.5: Polymer degradation and stability.Types of degradation.Mechanism of degradation.Factors affecting degradation. Polymer solutions. Process of dissolution of polymers.Thermodynamics of Dissolution. Flory-Huggins Theory, Viscosity of Polymeric solutions.

reference_books.book: Text Book of Polymer Science, Billmeyer, Fred W.
Principles of Polymer Systems By Ferdinand Rodriguez
Principles of Polymer Chemistry By A. Ravve
Introduction of Polymer Science By Hans-Georg Elias
Polymer Science & Technology By Joel R. Fried.
Polymer Science By Gowariker V R, Vishwanathan NV, Jayadev Sreedhar.
